page.layout: One block of running text in a single column, with the running head top left and the page number top right. Below the text, at the right, stands the bare section number "IX.".

main_text.p: VIII. Sed & Hieronymi videtur nu-tasse sententia, & hujus etiam se ruetur[?] Erasmus authoritate. Sanè Comment. in Amosi Caput VIII, dubius de Authore pronunciat: Quod, quicunque est ille qui ad Hebraeos scripsit Epistolam, disse-rens ait. Alibi septem tantùm Pauli ad Ecclesias recensèt Epistolas, exclusi-vè ad Ecclesiam Hebraeorum. Catalog. script. in Paulo, scripsit autem novem ad septem Ecclesias Epistolas, ad Romanos unam, &c. Comment. in Zachar. C. VIII. circa finem; Quae igitur septem ibi mulieres appellantur, i.e. Ecclesiae, (quarum numerus & in Paulo Apostolo continetur, ad septem enim scribit Ecclesias, ad Romanos, ad Corinthios, ad Galatas, ad Ephesios, ad Philippenses, ad Colof-senses, ad Thessalonicenses) Epistola ad Paulinum, de libris divinae script. quae est ciii. Operum Tom.iii. Paulus Apostolus ad septem scribit Ecclesias, octava enim ad Hebraeos à plerisque extrà locum ponitur.

page.notes: Printed text is clear apart from the word after "se" (read as "ruetur", doubtful) and the hyphenated word "disse-rens" (read as printed, doubtful). The Roman numerals "VIII" in "Caput VIII" and "Zachar. C. VIII" are set with irregular spacing in the scan; read as VIII. "ciii" and "Tom.iii" are printed in lower case. Small capitals in "ECCLESIAM" are rendered as "Ecclesiam". No catchword or signature is visible.
